newsitem.title: USA: U.S. SEC'S EDGAR filing system temporarily down.
newsitem.headline: U.S. SEC'S EDGAR filing system temporarily down.

text.p: A technical glitch has temporarily disabled the Securities and Exchange Commission's electronic filing system known as EDGAR, an agency spokesman said Tuesday.
SEC computer technicians are working to return the filing system to service, said spokesman John Heine.
The system, through which publicly-held corporations and investors send filings to the SEC, went on the blink at about 1530 EST (2030 GMT).
EDGAR stands for Electronic Data Gathering and Retrieval.
